multiplicity_correction: Bonferroni across 10 thresholds and 3 seeds; alpha = 0.05/30
selection: within each seed, maximize safe positive coverage among thresholds satisfying adjusted group upper error bound and zero accepted unknowns; ties choose higher threshold; no qualifying threshold means always abstain
group_failure: any unsafe accepted nonexact query in group; unknown acceptance prevents qualification
assumptions: Clopper-Pearson arithmetic conditional on independent Bernoulli group outcomes; purposive templates and shared lineages do not establish that assumption. No population guarantee. Lineage bound reported separately.
